title: Fallen-8 capacity report
description: The result file fallen-8-bench writes. It carries measured capacity and throughput numbers together with the environment that produced them, so a number is never published without the machine it belongs to. scripts/update-capacity-doc.mjs renders it into the Capacity and performance page.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of THIS schema. A consumer must refuse a major it does not know.

generatedAtUtc.description: When the run finished, ISO-8601 in UTC.

version.description: Informational version of the measuring tool.

source.description: What was measured. The commit is what makes a number reproducible.

commit.description: Git commit of the working tree, when it could be resolved.

dirtyWorkingTree.description: True when the tree had uncommitted changes, so the commit alone does not identify the code.

environment.description: The machine. Every number in metrics describes THIS environment and nothing else.

processorName.description: The CPU's own name, read from the hardware (CPUID brand string, or /proc/cpuinfo) rather than from user input, so it cannot contradict the machine that ran. Null only when no source was available.

runnerLabel.description: Free-form label for the machine, e.g. a CI runner image or "laptop".

profile.description: Which measurement set ran. "quick" is sized for CI, "full" for a real machine and larger graphs.

memory.description: Retained managed heap attributable to the graph, after a forced blocking compacting collection.

bytesPerVertex.description: Retained bytes per vertex with no edges attached.

bytesPerEdge.description: Retained bytes per edge including its adjacency slots.

retainedMb.description: Total retained megabytes for vertices plus edges.

writeThroughput.description: Committed single-element writes per second, WAL on, so the fsync and the group-commit amortisation are both in the number.

saveStall.description: How long a checkpoint holds the single writer thread, which is what a concurrent write waits.

load.description: How long restoring one namespace's checkpoint takes, i.e. what a boot pays per LOADED namespace. OPTIONAL, unlike the other four families: it was added after schema major 1 shipped, and requiring it would make every report recorded before it unreadable rather than merely incomplete. A consumer that finds it absent must say the run predates the measurement, never that the cost is zero.

loadMs.description: Engine construction plus the checkpoint restore, wall clock. The write-ahead-log tail is not included: a boot replays it on top, and its cost follows what was committed since the last save rather than the graph.

traversal.description: Raw out-edge traversal throughput, the same work GET /benchmark does.
